body:
Good morning!

The cows pushed down part of Mrs. Hannah's fence in the night. Nobody was hurt, but it needs mending.

I'm walking down the farm road with my tools. Will you meet me there?
summary: Put up new fence posts with Mr. Amos.

tasks.where: at Mrs. Hannah's farm (walk the farm road, or take the map)
from the jug in your kitchen
